title: Policy-led experiment orchestration with environment constraints
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Problem: We need a single experiment/rollout scheduler that lets teams run shadow trials, A/B experiments, and canary rollouts while respecting environment-specific constraints (Hosted, Dedicated, Private). Current workarounds are ad-hoc: hosted uses dynamic routing, dedicated uses capacity reservations with manual policies, and private deployments lack automated traffic split primitives. This causes drift in rollout behavior, error-prone configs, and missing telemetry in private deployments.

Goal: Ship a policy-driven experiment orchestration layer that: 
- Encodes rollout policies (shadow, canary, ramp, auto-rollback) as first-class resources;
- Allows environment-specific overrides (e.g., no external metrics exporters in Private, no burst autoscaling in Dedicated);
- Supports deterministic A/B bucketing and consistent user assignment;
- Implements safe auto-rollback triggers from SLO regressions, error spikes, and model-quality eval hooks;
- Maintains config parity where possible and documents explicit divergence points.

Non-goals: This ticket does not implement the end-to-end UI in Console (tiling in later ticket) nor does it include billing integration for experiment feature flags. It also defers model-level semantic eval integration beyond a webhook consumer for alerts.

Design summary: We will introduce an ExperimentPolicy CRD-like manifest (JSON over API) with the following top-level fields: type (shadow|canary|ab), slices (percentage weights), guardrails (latency_p95_threshold_ms, error_rate_delta_pct, cost_per_token_limit), evaluation_hooks (webhook endpoints), and environment_overrides (hosted:full, dedicated:limited-autoscale, private:local-routing-only). The orchestrator will be a control-plane service (policy-engine) that compiles policies into environment-specific route plans: hosted -> weighted router config + monitoring hooks; dedicated -> reservation-aware router + capacity-aware ramp; private -> local sidecar router + sampled telemetry collector that stores metrics locally and ships on allowed intervals.

Auto-rollback rules: policies can declare rollback_conditions with window (60s/5m), aggregation (p95, avg), and thresholds. The engine uses event-sourced telemetry and a short-circuit logic: immediate rollback on 5xx spike > 1% above baseline or p95 increase > 30% over baseline sustained for 3 consecutive windows. Rollback actions: immediate traffic shift to previous version, notify owners, and create a postmortem ticket template.

Observability and safety: Every rollout will be associated with an ephemeral experiment ID and a dashboard template (latency, error-rate, correctness-samples, cost per token). For Private, because of network restrictions, we provide a local dashboard and a scheduled export job when policy allows.

Trade-offs considered: 
- Centralized policy engine vs agent-based decision-making: we pick hybrid: central planner for policy compilation + lightweight agents in each environment for enforcement to reduce blast radius and respect Private air-gap constraints.
- Immediate rollback on noisy signal vs requiring corroboration: default uses corroborated signals (metric + anomaly detector or eval webhook), but allow emergency single-signal rollback for critical customer-impacting releases.

Migration: existing canary configs will be importable via a CLI shim. Teams should define guardrails explicitly; otherwise system defaults apply (conservative ramps).

Security notes: Private deployments must opt in to any telemetry exports. The policy manifest includes a "telemetry_policy" field that defaults to "local_only" for private deployments.
acceptance_criteria: ExperimentPolicy manifest schema defined and documented in Confluence (fields and semantics)
Policy-engine service compiles policies into per-environment route plans and exposes dry-run API
Enforcement agents implemented for hosted and dedicated; private agent runs in local control-plane with no external dependencies
Deterministic A/B bucketing implemented with stable hashing and documented migration plan
Auto-rollback mechanics implemented with configurable windows and default conservative thresholds
E2E test that runs a shadow -> canary -> auto-rollback scenario against a synthetic model and verifies expected actions
Observability: dashboard template auto-created for each experiment and telemetry sampling honored for private deployments
tasks: Build lightweight enforcement agents for hosted/dedicated/private
Add deterministic bucketing library to SDKs (python/ts) and rollout controller
E2E tests and chaos scenarios (network partitions, delayed metrics)
Confluence design doc and migration guide
Security review and legal sign-off for telemetry export flows
